# DonutChart

## Overview

Complete donut chart visualization that orchestrates ChartHeader, ChartLegend, DonutPathGroup, optional InlineChartKeyGroup, and ChartFooter into a cohesive chart layout.

**Features:**

- Full chart layout with title, subtitle, legend, and source/notes
- D3-powered donut arc generation via DonutPathGroup
- Categorical colours from `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}` CSS custom properties — no hard-coded values
- Optional centred DataDisplay for summary values (static or hover-driven)
- Optional InlineChartKeyGroup as a detailed legend with values
- Accessibility support with screen reader summaries via ChartAccessibility

All tokens flow through the Convex → `generateDataVisCSS` → `useStyleInjection` → `@layer brand` pipeline — no JS token resolver.

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `214:4887`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=214-4887

## Architecture

```
DonutChart (div[data-name="donutChart"])
├── ChartHeader (title + subtitle)                       — optional
├── ChartLegend (categorical legend, up to 6 items)      — optional
├── div[data-name="donutWrapper"]
│   └── DonutPathGroup (fillContainer=true)
│       ├── shapes (SVG donut arcs)
│       └── dataDisplay (centred metrics)                — optional
├── InlineChartKeyGroup (detailed legend with values)    — optional
└── ChartFooter (source + notes)                         — optional
```

The `donutWrapper` grows to fill available height (`flex: 1 0 0`) so the ring always fills the space between the header and footer.

## Import

```tsx
import { DonutChart } from './components/charts/DonutChart';
```

| --------------------- | --------------------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

| `width`               | `number \| string`    | `346`   | Container width in px or CSS string (e.g. `"100%"`).                             |
| `height`              | `number \| string`    | `524`   | Container height in px or CSS string.                                            |

## DonutGroupConfig

| Property            | Type                                | Default      | Description                                                                    |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `arcWidth`          | `"auto" \| ArcWidthSize`            | `"auto"`     | Ring width. Auto scales with chart width; explicit T-shirt size overrides.     |
| `innerRadiusRatio`  | `number` (0–1)                      | derived      | Inner radius ratio. Overrides `arcWidth` calculation.                          |
| `startAngle`        | `number`                            | `0`          | Start angle in degrees (0 = 3 o'clock, −90 = 12 o'clock).                     |
| `padAngle`          | `number`                            | `0`          | Gap between segments in degrees.                                               |
| `dataDisplay`       | `boolean`                           | `true`       | Show centred DataDisplay.                                                      |
| `dataDisplayConfig` | `DonutDataDisplayConfig`            | `{}`         | Configuration for the centred DataDisplay.                                     |
| `hoverBadge`        | `boolean`                           | `false`      | Show cursor-following badge on arc hover.                                      |
| `hoverBadgeConfig`  | `DonutHoverBadgeConfig`             | `{}`         | Custom formatter for hover badge value.                                        |
| `onArcHover`        | `(data: DonutArcHoverData) => void` | —            | Fired on any arc hover state change.                                           |
| `onArcClick`        | `(data: DonutArcHoverData) => void` | —            | Fired on arc click or Enter/Space.                                             |
| `hoveredArcIndex`   | `number`                            | —            | Controlled hover — pins highlighted arc externally.                            |
| `dataSort`          | `DataSortOrder`                     | `"unsorted"` | Sort arc segments: `"asc"`, `"desc"`, or `"unsorted"`.                         |

| Property                   | Type                                        | Default    | Description                                                          |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`                     | `"static" \| "hover"`                       | `"static"` | Static uses fixed values; hover updates from arc hover state.        |
| `mainLabelValue`           | `string`                                    | —          | Label above the lead value.                                          |
| `formatHoverLeadValue`     | `(value, category?, percentage?) => string` | —          | Custom formatter for lead value in hover mode.                       |
| `formatHoverBadgeValue`    | `(value, category?, percentage?) => string` | —          | Custom formatter for badge value in hover mode.                      |
| `rightBadgeWrapper` | `boolean`                                   | `false`    | Show the supporting content section (where badge lives).             |

| `showBadge`                | `boolean`                                   | `true`     | Toggle all badge instances.                                          |
| `badgeConfig`              | `BadgeConfig`                               | `{}`       | Badge value and appearance (`positive`/`negative`/`warning`/`informative`). |
| `size`                | `'XS' \| 'S' \| 'M' \| 'L' \| 'XL'`       | `'L'`      | Typography scale for the DataDisplay.                                |
| `dataHead`                 | `DataHeadConfig`                            | `{}`       | Lead value, supporting value, and label configuration.               |

## Design Tokens

### Categorical Colours

Segment colours are CSS custom property references resolved at paint time from `@layer brand`:

| Segments | CSS variable                          | Source                                        |
| -------- | ------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| 1–6      | `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1` … `6`  | Brand-uploaded palette via DataVis pipeline   |
| 7–12     | `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-7` … `12` | Extended fallback (`datavis-categorical-extended.css`) |

Legend colours use the same CSS var references — they update automatically when the brand or theme changes.

### Layout Token

| Property         | CSS variable                                     | Default     |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ----------- |
| Section gap      | `var(--DonutChart-gap, var(--Spacing-5))`        | `--Spacing-5` (~20px) |

---

## Accessibility

Wrapped by `ChartAccessibility` with `chartType="donut"`. Provides:
- `role="figure"` with `aria-label` (from title or `accessibility.ariaLabel`)
- Auto-generated screen reader summary describing data range and extremes
- Visually-hidden data table when `accessibility.dataTable=true` (default)
- ARIA live region for hover/focus announcements (debounced 150ms)
- `aria-controls` linking arc buttons to the centred DataDisplay

## Usage Examples

### Basic donut with header, legend, and centred summary

```tsx
<DonutChart
  data={[
    { category: 'Product A', value: 35 },
    { category: 'Product B', value: 25 },
    { category: 'Product C', value: 20 },
    { category: 'Product D', value: 12 },
    { category: 'Product E', value: 8 },
  ]}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Revenue Distribution',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'By product category',
  }}
  donutGroupConfig={{
    dataDisplay: true,
    dataDisplayConfig: {
      mainLabelValue: 'Revenue',
      supportingBadgeLabelValue: 'vs last month',
      rightBadgeWrapper: true,
      dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '£2,390' },
      badgeConfig: { value: '+12.5%', appearance: 'positive' },
    },
    hoverBadge: true,
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{ annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Analytics' }}
/>
```

### Progress ring (two segments, top start)

```tsx
<DonutChart
  data={[
    { category: 'Completed', value: 75 },
    { category: 'Remaining', value: 25 },
  ]}
  chartLegend={false}
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Project Progress' }}
  donutGroupConfig={{
    arcWidth: 'XL',
    startAngle: -90,
    dataDisplay: true,
    dataDisplayConfig: {
      mainLabelValue: 'Completion',
      dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '75%' },
    },
  }}
/>
```

### With InlineChartKeyGroup

```tsx
<DonutChart
  data={data}
  chartLegend={false}
  inlineChartKeyGroup
  donutGroupConfig={{ dataDisplay: true, dataDisplayConfig: { mainLabelValue: 'Total' } }}
  inlineChartKeyGroupConfig={{
    formatValue: (v) => `£${v.toLocaleString()}`,
    showPercentage: true,
  }}
/>
```

### Full width

```tsx
<DonutChart data={data} fullWidth chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Revenue' }} />
```

### Hover mode — DataDisplay updates on arc hover

```tsx
<DonutChart
  data={data}
  donutGroupConfig={{
    dataDisplay: true,
    dataDisplayConfig: {
      mode: 'hover',
      mainLabelValue: 'Hover a segment',
      rightBadgeWrapper: true,
      dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '—' },
      formatHoverLeadValue: (value) => `£${value.toLocaleString()}`,
      formatHoverBadgeValue: (_, _cat, pct) => `${pct?.toFixed(1)}%`,
      supportingBadgeLabelValue: 'of total',
      badgeConfig: { value: '—' },
    },
  }}
/>
```
